primary.name: Free Office Layout Plan
primary.description: Submit brief → receive professional CAD layout + product recommendations within 48 hours
primary.conversionValue: Very High — demonstrates expertise, creates obligation, captures detailed brief
primary.qualificationGate: Require: staff count, move date, budget range — this qualifies the lead before they access the offer
primary.followUpSequence: 48hr delivery → 24hr later call or email → weekly touchpoint for 4 weeks

secondary.name: AI Office Planner
secondary.value: Interactive space planning — upload floor plan, get AI-powered zone recommendations
secondary.conversionSignal: High — prospect is in active planning mode

secondary.name: Office Fitout Cost Calculator
secondary.value: Enter staff count, zone types, quality tier → receive instant project estimate
secondary.conversionSignal: Medium-High — reveals budget and project scope

secondary.name: Free Workplace Strategy Call
secondary.value: 30-minute video call with a workspace consultant for projects $50k+
secondary.conversionSignal: Very High — only quality leads book a call
secondary.qualificationNote: Add a brief intake form before booking — filters out low-value enquiries

outboundLeadGeneration.strategy: Identify companies in the active planning window (signed lease, hiring surge, funding announcement) and make personalised first contact
outreachChannels: Direct email to Office Manager / EA
Phone to reception, ask for facilities or office manager
outboundLeadGeneration.outreachScript: We noticed [company] has been growing rapidly / recently signed a new lease at [address]. We help companies like yours plan and furnish new workspaces — we've just completed projects for [comparable company type]. I'd love to offer a free layout plan for your new space. Is [name] the right person to speak with?
outboundLeadGeneration.avoid: Generic mass emails, LinkedIn spam, phone cold calls without a specific reason

targetReferrers: IT companies (who are involved in office moves)
referralStrategy.referralMechanism: No formal commission required — quality service and proactive relationship management generates referrals organically
referralStrategy.formalPartnership: For high-volume referrers (agents, designers), offer 2–5% referral arrangement on confirmed orders. Put in writing with simple 1-page agreement.
referralStrategy.postProjectReferralTiming: Best time to ask for a referral: 4–8 weeks after handover when client has settled in and is proud of the result
